provenance.dataset: ULB Credit Card Fraud Detection (Dal Pozzolo et al., ULB/Worldline)
provenance.source: OpenML dataset 1597 (creditcard), ARFF mirror of the Kaggle release
provenance.license_note: Made available for research use per the dataset's public release; PCA features are anonymized and contain no direct personal data.
provenance.currency_note: ULB amounts are EUR. The cost analysis treats amounts as USD-equivalent; all dollar figures are simulated operating costs under the documented cost model, not realized bank savings.

dataset_audit.duplicate_policy: Exact duplicate rows are dropped before splitting to prevent train-to-test duplicate leakage (duplicate feature vectors with conflicting labels are retained as genuine ambiguous cases).
dataset_audit.timestamp_semantics: 'Time' = seconds elapsed since the first transaction; rows arrive in chronological order, enabling a strict chronological split.
dataset_audit.entity_identifiers: None. ULB is PCA-anonymized card data; no graph features are used.

protocol.features: V1..V28 + Amount (Time excluded as split key)
protocol.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on training partition only
protocol.policy: exact optimizer fitted on validation, frozen test evaluation
